work.abstract_text: We correct the conjecture in comment 2 of Peter Kagey's OEIS A343881, revision 16 (June 14, 2021), and extend results of Kagey (2015) and Adenwalla (2025): the proposed value 72 at k=12 is inadmissible for every exponent n>=2. The exact prime-exponent minima are 27, 18, and 54 at p=2,3,5, respectively, and 144 at every prime p>=7. More generally, writing k=r^g with the prime-exponent vector of r having greatest common divisor 1, we prove that T(p,k)=r^(g+1) for all sufficiently large primes, with an explicit threshold. This gives the precise range in which the proposed formula k rad(k) is correct. We also prove the entry's distinct-prime-row assertion and first-column formula using the same valuation description. For the cross-referenced sequence minimum in A343825, we prove eventual equality with A071537 by an explicit determinant bound and reprove Adenwalla's k=12 prime column: 20 at p=2 and 18 at every odd prime. The valuation classes also answer the image questions in Kagey's Open problem collection, Problem 16: they characterize the cube-row image and show that the two-value rows are injective exactly at prime exponents.

work.title: Correction of OEIS A343881, comment 2, revision 16: extensions of Kagey (2015) and Adenwalla (2025)
